selectionPolicy.primary: N1 vocabulary workbook coverage and official JLPT item-type relevance
selectionPolicy.secondary: licensed dictionary identity, reading, Korean meaning, and natural project-authored examples
exclude: basic or broadly elementary vocabulary unless needed for an N1 contrast/usage question
selectionPolicy.priorityNote: Official JLPT does not publish complete per-word frequency data. This is a transparent N1 study priority, not a claimed official probability.

candidateSelectionCheckpoint.note: The 280 rows are a review queue only. Do not delete or replace existing daily data until each row has a verified reading, Korean meaning, usage/example, N1 suitability reason, and question-quality check.

activeBatchCheckpoint.note: The content is rebuilt against the priority-refined 280-word proposal. The generator now has a clean-clone fallback to the committed canonical candidate pool, and the first-batch queue excludes explicitly low-priority everyday/broad entries in favor of formal, abstract, institutional, legal, and logical reading vocabulary. All 210 linked vocabulary MCQs, 28 grammar lessons, 42 grammar MCQs, 14 original reading sets, and 42 reading MCQs pass structural, answer, date-link, sentence-blank, and scanned historical exact-reuse checks. The generated migration is limited to this plan and this 14-day date range, has no plan-wide curriculum delete or COUNT scan, and is ready for the user to apply.
